answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a season of verified useful work, so spawning a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand stakes and waiting out the same slow season each time. Like a lantern carried across an ocean, reputation is earned one verified crossing at a time and cannot be copied in bulk; a nebula of cheap fake accounts collapses because each one must pay the same entry cost and the same waiting time before it earns anything.
